metricDefinitions.label: Book 증가
metricDefinitions.definition: 동일 Shop의 공식 누적 Book 두 시점 차이. 원 단위를 10,000으로 나누어 만원으로 표시합니다.

metricDefinitions.label: 전체 순위
metricDefinitions.definition: 공개된 점수가 있는 참가자에서 자신보다 점수가 높은 수 + 1. 학생 순위는 별도 모집단입니다.

metricDefinitions.label: Buyer 구매 성공률
metricDefinitions.definition: 기간 안에 생성되고 종료된 주문 중 실제 구매한 주문 수 / 종료 주문 수. 식품과 공산품을 분리합니다.

filters: 보드 비교: 두 시점에 같은 이름으로 존재하는 상위 Shop 5곳과 seochanit.
저널 비교: 실행 시작 전후 동일한 2.565시간. 미종료 주문은 성공률 분모에서 제외.
Shop 매출 대조: unit별 중복 제거한 shop_settled 기록.

caveats: Ranks use published scored populations, include house, and use competition ties.
Frozen board metrics and current KV/inventory read times differ; KV values are not reconstructed historical values.
Before/after windows have equal duration but market availability, peers, mix and outcome follow-up differ; no causal lift is identified.
New goods quality has not reached six-hour maturity; historical canonical backfill is not new-strategy quality evidence.
Refund amounts in a window include older sales; margin-minus-refunds is a cash-flow-style reconciliation, not a cohort loss rate.
Snapshot registry inventory excludes offline shops; board stock includes them. Do not infer demand from an empty registry.
Shop rating predictions remain shadow and do not improve price decisions yet.
The strategy deployment snapshot begins 77 seconds before runtime startup; Buyer board delta 182 and post-start journal purchases 178 have different windows.
Registry and board requests can race an address rotation; a temporary zero deal count on one earlier board was not a persistent loss: 8542 deals are present at the frozen cutoff.
Control sample counts are not outage durations or causal lost sales.
Inventory, control and usage are read at their recorded snapshot times, not reconstructed to the frozen board cutoff.
The effective inventory ceiling is 180, not the legacy base target of 60; 66 current units do not bind that ceiling.
A supply execution status is an execution record, not independently reconciled acquired inventory.

methods.code: Book change (만원) = (current official book - prior official book) / 10000; ranks = 1 + count(scored participants with strictly higher official score).
